title: objectql: publish a driver conformance kit that out-of-repo plugin drivers run in their own CI, so a contract change here is caught there — epic #27261 P2
body:
epic:#27261#1 · marchtian · session_017ihL2c5z3q4h8inrn5kwqV
Filing gate: ③ maintainer-directed — 田騏 at 2026-10-29T21:58Z 「现在启动全部 P2」 (epic comment 6509296853, D1 amended), at 2026-10-29T21:59Z 「OData 驱动 只做 v4」 (6509311454), at 2026-10-29T22:01Z 「同意」 (generic P2 parts open source in this repository; vendor-specific drivers such as Salesforce stay out of it).
Ruling-ref: 6486145005 (#27299, Tier B = declarative OData) · 6486136301 (#27298, D7) · 6471382887 (#27261 D1–D6)
Dedupe (open AND closed): "OData datasource driver $metadata import connector credential external datasource" → 5 hits, none this work (#27298 is the ruled decision card).
Reader: the epic PM (#27261) dispatches it in the epic subtree.
type: Feature

## 维护者速读

- **做什么：** 把插件驱动必须满足的行为（读、筛选下推与兜底、计数、写入拒绝映射、`introspectSchema`）做成一个可发布的测试套件，仓库外的驱动（如闭源的 Salesforce 驱动）在自己的 CI 里跑。
- **为什么：** 厂商专属驱动按 22:01Z 的决定放在仓库外；这套用例是开源仓接口变化时及时发现不兼容的唯一手段。
- **需要您做的：** 无。

## Task

- [ ] An exported kit (in `@objectstack/objectql` or a small test-kit package) taking a driver factory and a fixture set, asserting the floor contract (#27277): reads, `supports`-declared pushdown agrees with the in-memory evaluator on the spec conformance case tables, counts, write refusal statuses, and `introspectSchema` shape when present.
- [ ] `driver-odata` runs it in this repository as the first consumer; the guide's plugin-driver section points to it.
- [ ] It stays the oracle the epic's P3 "verified-pushdown credential" will build on.

`Clause-②:` decided by the dev (a new public export) · `Metadata-protocol: none`.
